source_scope_issues.detail: No independent clinical approval of gyri/sulci, thalamic regional or nuclear boundaries, pallidal segments, capsule limbs, cerebellar lobules or peduncles. Regional entries do not close fine anatomy scope.
Brain Anatomy includes labelled axial and regional illustrations. Every embedded label and adjacent structure still needs source-image review; the inventory is not an exhaustive closed list.
Arterial and venous territories vary and overlap. Patient-specific flow, patency, variant branching and supply cannot be inferred from a normative parent mesh or static map.

Linked vascular reading includes infarction, watershed, lacunar, PRES and venous thrombosis contexts. Corresponding disease modules and all lesion-dependent adjacent structures require separate reconciliation.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Acquired DICOM orientation and side markers with multi-planar registration.
Appropriate angiographic or venographic acquisition; anatomical models alone are insufficient.
Case anatomy, distribution and variants; distinguish reference maps from individual perfusion.
Calibrated orthogonal image planes and reproducible named landmarks; model dimensions are not clinical measurements.

source_scope_issues.detail: Source segment conventions and all labelled source-image anatomy require explicit reconciliation. No fixed 16/18-segment denominator is assumed from the finite vessel groups.
Acquisition phase, lumen opacification, calcium scoring, calibrated stenosis/plaque measurements, CT-FFR and perfusion require method-specific evidence; a static model does not prove them.
Every depicted anomaly, lesion, non-atherosclerotic exception, stent/graft and adjacent anatomy needs exact case scope; draft conditional groups are not exhaustive.
Generic cardiac/extracardiac headings must be expanded into the actual structures reported in each acquisition. Coverage is not established by a broad parent label.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Appropriate non-contrast CT, vessel assignment and validated method; contrast CTA or coloured mesh surfaces are not substitute measurements.
Calibrated orthogonal acquired lumen sections and appropriate reference; document motion/blooming and non-evaluable extent.
Method-specific source images and lesion-localised morphology, separate from stenosis and histological assertions.
Validated physiological analysis linked to the specific lesion/territory; static anatomy alone proves no physiological value.
Suitable acquired phases and calibration; static external walls cannot establish dynamic compression, chamber volumes or shunt significance.

targets: Every actual subsegmental bronchus/vessel and reported segment
Left nomenclature, branching, fissural and situs variants
Each stenosis, nodule, plug, mass and affected airway
Every expiratory/dynamic acquisition correspondence
Each intervention and altered residual anatomy
Acquired nodes/pleura/mediastinal or vascular conditions
Developmental and disease-specific contexts

source_scope_issues.detail: The eighteen common source segment entries are not an exhaustive invariant patient tree. Subsegmental divisions, venous/lymphatic localisation and precise territory boundaries require source/case expansion.
Combined or separate left apicoposterior and basal conventions must be reconciled with actual anatomy, rather than silently recoded or duplicated.
Expiration, central collapse, bronchoarterial ratios, small-airway visibility and CT tissue boundaries require appropriate acquired evidence and calibration, separate from static schematics.

All source-image labels and conditional wall disease, masses, developmental anomalies, surgery, valves, fibrosis and vascular consequences require full case-specific anatomy and diagnostic-context review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Calibrated orthogonal acquired lumen planes; obliquity and motion limits stated.
Matched acquired bronchus/artery level with perfusion context and additional CT morphology; no generic surface ratio.
Appropriate paired inspiratory/expiratory acquisition and adequacy; unacquired expiration cannot be reported negative.
Relevant dynamic/expiratory acquisition, matched levels and measurement method.
Appropriate contrast or functional source acquisitions; anatomical territory diagrams are not measured supply.

targets: Every primary, solid component, separate lesion and actual affected segment/subsegment
Each named invasive interface, laterality and acquired structure
Every individual node, station boundary and station 3A side; optional right station 11 subdivisions where used
Every actual metastatic lesion, organ system and acquisition field of view
Every source/case morphology, developmental condition and treatment-related alteration

source_scope_issues.detail: Named station and interface lists are a draft. Source/case meshes, actual node boundaries, vascular/neural extent and all imaged sites require expansion and specialist review.

IASLC 9th-edition card page 10 is the current definition source. Older linked node-map prose contains a 3B typo and describes 3P differently; original labels and side/border distinctions require reconciliation before image/model binding.
CT-visible component, nerve relationship, pleural contact, nodal size and effusion cannot establish microscopic invasion, histology, STAS or malignant involvement.
PET-CT, brain imaging, tissue sampling and prior scans are separate evidence; chest/upper-abdominal coverage cannot exclude whole-body disease.
The IASLC card explicitly requires permission before reproducing its figures for distribution. Source review is not a commercial reuse grant; no card image is packaged.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Calibrated native planes, reconstruction and appropriate windows, with atelectasis excluded only when distinguishable.

functional_evidence_requirements.observation: node short axis and station count
functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual source planes, separate station definitions and primary laterality; a node count is not an N2 station count.
Site-specific imaging confidence and confirmatory evidence when stage changing; contact geometry alone does not prove invasion.
Actual findings and diagnostic confirmation/context; fluid presence alone does not establish malignant effusion.
Complete lesion/site evidence in acquired studies with uncertainty and unseen sites stated; paired organs and multiple bone sites require organ-system review.
Pathological evidence separate from CT appearance; CT solid component or illustrative histology is not patient proof.
Known treatment/time point and actual matched prior studies; pretreatment c and post-treatment yc contexts kept distinct.

source_scope_issues.detail: Older radiographic source divisions are not automatically equivalent to the modern CT scheme. All actual compartment boundaries, mass epicentres and source labels require reconciliation.

Numeric annotation IDs, connected components and sampled source masks do not establish node identity, station assignment or complete clinical coverage; NIH single-plane label and LNQ topology issues remain held.
Intensity, enhancement, contact, displacement, suspected necrosis and pathology need acquired source/context review. Generic geometry does not confirm histology or invasion.
All original image labels, age contexts, differential examples, procedure relationships and reuse rights require case-specific review before representation binding.
Appropriate contrast timing, MRI for unresolved neural/soft-tissue relationships, actual field-of-view and unseen structures remain explicit evidence requirements.

functional_evidence_requirements.observation: mass dimensions and node short axis
functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Calibrated source planes with mass/node measurement methods distinguished; no generic atlas measurement.
Appropriate acquired windows, phase/timing and calibrated source intensities. A single-phase or converted image is not a before/after comparison.
Appropriate contrast/source continuity and uncertainty; do not infer a solid mass or patent vessel from schematic shape.
Actual acquired interfaces and complementary/confirmatory evidence when needed; contact alone is not invasion.
Imaging composition/uncertainty distinguished from definitive tissue diagnosis; source-example histology is not patient proof.
Actual source age/treatment time point and prior studies; no adult/pretreatment substitution.

source_scope_issues.detail: Common Couinaud entries are not patient-measured territories. Source-specific vessel/duct branches, variants and boundaries need expansion and anatomical review.
Each claimed modality, phase, agent and sequence requires suitable acquired evidence. A permitted modality list is not proof of full modality/sequence coverage.
Every lesion and all actual acquired extrahepatic sites need explicit coverage; a selected target or parent-organ surface cannot waive the rest.
Source examples and category labels do not prove this patient eligibility, histology or response. General masses, untreated diagnosis and treatment response remain separate.
Original image/mask/registration rights, measured native sampling and cross-phase alignment need independent source review. Restricted AMPLIFAI annotations are not commercially cleared.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual branching/territory and acquired orthogonal planes; schematic hepatic/portal planes do not measure source segment boundaries.
Complete eligible observation margin and phase, matched prior acquisition/date, calibration and uncertainty; do not count adjacent perfusion change.
Actual acquired phase/agent, adequacy and same-observation correspondence; unacquired or degraded phases remain unassessed.
Apply current agent/phase definitions separately; gadoxetate transitional/hepatobiliary hypointensity is not diagnostic washout.
Appropriate source sequences, b-values/ADC, in/opposed-phase and source alignment; no CT substitution or static model proof.

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft parent entries are not a closed patient anatomy list; instantiate actual branches, variants and lesions.
Appropriate original CT/MRI phases and sequences are required; generic organ geometry supplies no enhancement or MRI signal.
Macroscopic fat strongly supports classic AML in context; rare RCC exceptions and microscopic fat remain distinct. Pattern is not histology.
Contact and label size do not establish invasion or metastatic state; covered field and actual venous upper extent need review.
Source images, annotations and derivatives need independent rights, native geometry and anatomical review. No complete renal source is approved.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual side, complete lesion margins, calibrated orthogonal planes and repeatable prior correspondence.
Independent fat, blood, calcification, fluid and solid-region source evidence; no histological shortcut.
Original calibrated pre/post source phases, same-tissue ROI, noise/partial volume and pseudoenhancement uncertainty.
Actual T2, chemical shift, suppression, subtraction and DWI/ADC if acquired, with motion and field strength considered.
Original lumen/wall/tissue boundaries, actual venous level and covered upper extent.
Actual compartment/organ extension evidence; adjacency is not invasion.
Every actual acquired observation and source disease context; negative field cannot establish unacquired whole-body status.
Source pathology and clinical context distinguish overlapping solid tumour patterns and normal/infectious/vascular mimics.

targets: Every actual eligible observation, wall region, septum and protrusion with whole acquired extent
Each source CT/MRI phase/sequence, measurement region and clinically relevant technical limitation
Every actual prior/current morphology change and source diagnostic context
Actual acquired renal and nearby structure/variant interfaces; do not borrow solid-mass or whole-body staging coverage

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype wall/septum/nodule entries require each actual source feature and full extent; parent shells are insufficient.
Clinical feature dimensions, perpendicular planes and source uncertainty must be independently demonstrated.
Actual paired technique and adequate source acquisition required; geometric models cannot verify enhancement or MRI patterns.
General-population applicability, exclusions and correct-phase CT/MRI benign/IIF exceptions need review; solid masses and hereditary context are not silently treated as ordinary eligible cysts.
Original imaging, annotation and derivative rights and anatomical validity remain unapproved; CPTAC malignant ROI is not reused as a verified Bosniak cyst.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual cystic fraction, appropriate protocol, exclusions and clinical/hereditary context.
Resolved native sampling, perpendicular wall/septal/protrusion measurements, partial-volume/motion limits and uncertainty.
Separate acquired connected septa with complete attachments; multiple cuts do not create multiple septa.
Actual matched pre/post technique, visible or quantitative enhancement and appropriate artifact checks; non-diagnostic data stays limited.
Actual enhancing tissue, source convexity, acute/obtuse interface and perpendicular protrusion size.
Actual unenhanced T1/T2/fat-saturated sequences and adequate subtraction; CT cannot substitute.
Full v2019 highest-feature assessment and applicable exceptions; category is not pathology or automatic management.
Matched source dates/observation and actual morphology; stable size is not complete stable feature evidence.

targets: Every actual observation, duct segment, artery/vein branch, variant and acquired contact/tissue region
Actual tumour-site/edition-specific nodal stations and every acquired distant observation
Actual original pancreatic/portal/other CT phases and any MRI adjunct sequence with native sampling and correspondence
Actual diagnosis/differential, treatment time point and prior/current source context

source_scope_issues.detail: Source-specific branches, variants, observations and whole margins require explicit instances; prototype entries are not a complete patient anatomy list.
Original calibrated orthogonal vessel planes, angle/length/contour and acquired phase adequacy remain unverified; normal atlas contact geometry cannot substitute.
Name the actual current resectability framework/version and time point; historical criteria or isolated angles do not prove operative suitability.
Regional status depends on source scheme/site/edition and actual diagnosis; unacquired coverage and source node size labels do not establish metastatic absence/presence.
CT pathway soft tissue is not microscopic perineural invasion; treated perivascular tissue may remain viability-uncertain.
Every actual image/annotation/derived structure needs independent rights, original sampling and anatomical review; no new pancreatic source/model is approved.

The shared lesson also contains pancreatic cyst/neuroendocrine content and quizzes that require separate source/criteria reconciliation. This CT staging inventory does not approve those topics, complete current NCCN/DPCG algorithms or the whole curriculum surface.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual whole tumour/duct margins, source contrast phase, dimensions, cut-off and upstream parenchyma.
Actual named vessel/variant, perpendicular plane, centreline, circumferential/longitudinal contact and contour; no generic threshold-based eligibility.
Actual source opacification, contour, filling defect/occlusion, collateral routes and proximal/distal patency; surgical feasibility remains multidisciplinary.
Actual acquired tissue planes/routes and diagnostic confidence; imaging appearance is not microscopic invasion.
Actual source observations and site/edition-specific station mapping; no histological inference from size alone.
Treatment dates/type, matched original source examination and progression/viability uncertainty; persistent anatomy is not an automatic surgical exclusion.
Actually acquired MRI sequences, b-values/ADC and source correspondence, not CT or unmeasured static-model signal.
Actual current framework/version, patient diagnosis, treatment time point, local/distant extent and multidisciplinary interpretation; software geometry is not operative judgement.

targets: Every actual collection, compartment extension, duct/vessel segment and anatomical variant
Actual adequate acquired contrast phases and conditional MRI/ultrasound evidence
Actual symptom onset, interventions, clinical severity records and prior examination correspondence

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype targets are not an exhaustive patient-specific collection/branch list.
Original onset, adequate phase, complete wall/content and early uncertainty need independent source review.
Modified Marshall measurements, qualifying organ failure duration and systemic/local complications cannot be inferred from model shape or CT score.
Gas, fever, instruments and fistula possibilities need context; anatomy alone does not establish infection or a mandatory treatment.
Duct/vessel walls and lumina, original source resolution/rights and independent anatomy review remain unapproved.
Broader management, clinical severity and intervention quiz assertions require complete separate reconciliation; this inventory does not certify them.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Adequate source phase, onset interval, whole acquired extent and explicit early uncertainty.
Actual content, complete/incomplete wall and source onset; no automatic calendar switch.
Qualifying clinical organ measurements/duration and complications; no anatomical or CT score substitution.
Actual clinical/instrumentation/fistula context; source gas is not stand-alone microbiology.
Actual source duct and viable-gland correspondence with modality-specific confirmation if needed.
Adequate source arterial/venous phases and actual lumen/wall/bleeding regions; static normal models cannot depict thrombosis or perfusion.
Source symptoms, urgency, source anatomy and specialist assessment; no route/timing decision from geometry alone.

targets: Every actual cyst/locule/nodule/duct connection, acquired phase and sequence
Source-specific clinical risk framework, year, competing causes and diagnostic uncertainty
Actual source histology/cytology if available, not inferred from appearance

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype entries require actual lesion/branch/region instances and complete acquired extent.
Subtraction quality, native source images, motion/partial volume and duct junctions need independent review.
Kyoto criteria apply to presumed IPMN and differ from Fukuoka/European/other protocols; this descriptor overview is not a full current management algorithm.
Morphology, duct calibre and cyst type do not establish histological malignancy or automatic operative suitability.
The shared solid/cystic pancreatic lesson has remaining clinical/management assertions requiring complete reconciliation.
Every actual source image, model and case state requires version-specific rights, original sampling and independent anatomy review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual complete observation margins, locules and comparable source measurements.
Actual enhancement evidence with pre/post/subtraction adequacy; no single-plane or gravity-position shortcut.
Actual thin-source course/junction and uncertainty; communication alone does not prove cyst histology.
Named applicable guideline/year plus full clinical/cytology context; risk findings are not pathological confirmation.
Actual symptoms, competing risk, diagnostic confidence, patient fitness and specialist assessment; no cyst-type-only operation.
Only actually acquired CT/MRI/MRCP or adjuncts can support modality-specific morphology/phase/functional claims.

Actual diagnosis, primary type, treatment time point and prior/current correspondence

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype entries are not exhaustive acquired region/observation instances.
CT nonvisualization cannot establish absence of small deposits or unacquired disease.
CT-estimated PCI is not surgical PCI; suitability requires primary-specific framework and multidisciplinary assessment.
Ascites, scalloping or distribution do not establish histology or a unique biological cause.
Shared hernia, abdominal-wall, drainage and differential management assertions require separate full review.
Every source image/model requires original sampling, actual phase, rights and independent fine anatomical review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual source compartment margins, connections and surface/bowel/vessel interfaces.
Adequate original CT phases and source-specific tissue/debris/fat/calcification, not generic mesh colouring.
Actual primary/clinical/pathology context and differential; no histology from ascites or distribution.
Source coverage, each actual deposit, individual regional scores if used and explicit unassessed/uncertain regions.
Exact source extent, current primary-specific framework, treatment and specialist judgement; no universal CT-score-only verdict.
Actually acquired MRI sequences and source correspondence; CT or static models cannot supply DWI/ADC signal.

Actual field coverage, source-specific PCI regions and unassessed areas

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype entries are not exhaustive acquired region/observation instances.
CT nonvisualization cannot establish absence of small deposits or unacquired disease.
CT-estimated PCI is not surgical PCI; suitability requires primary-specific framework and multidisciplinary assessment.
Ascites, scalloping or distribution do not establish histology or a unique biological cause.
Shared hernia, abdominal-wall, drainage and differential management assertions require separate full review.
Every source image/model requires original sampling, actual phase, rights and independent fine anatomical review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual source compartment margins, connections and surface/bowel/vessel interfaces.
Adequate original CT phases and source-specific tissue/debris/fat/calcification, not generic mesh colouring.
Actual primary/clinical/pathology context and differential; no histology from ascites or distribution.
Source coverage, each actual deposit, individual regional scores if used and explicit unassessed/uncertain regions.
Exact source extent, current primary-specific framework, treatment and specialist judgement; no universal CT-score-only verdict.
Actually acquired MRI sequences and source correspondence; CT or static models cannot supply DWI/ADC signal.

Separate normal anatomy, positive pathology, endocrine function and framework eligibility

source_scope_issues.detail: The 2025 proposal and ESE/ENSAT 2023 guideline retain distinct populations, imaging recommendations and threshold evidence.
Prototype targets are not exhaustive case-specific lesion/branch/variant instances; acquired field and fine structures need independent review.
Capsule/cortex/medulla and vessel walls require actual adequate source evidence; routine gland segmentation cannot prove their fine boundaries.
Hormonal production or adrenal insufficiency cannot be established from normal gland geometry, fat or washout alone.
Normal gland models cannot stand for positive tumour, haemorrhage, fat-containing mimics or invasion.
Every figure/model needs native sampling, actual sequences/phases, original rights and independent anatomical validation.
Aldosteronism lateralization, ACTH investigation, acute haemorrhage management and broader endocrine/genetic claims need their own complete primary-source review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Original whole-lesion composition and true noncontrast/matched MRI data, without a reassuring focal component standing for heterogeneity.
Actual acquisition times, matched ROIs and selected framework/population; percentages do not prove diagnosis.
Dated comparable maximum axes with both absolute and percentage change; no fabricated prior stability.
Independent clinical/biochemical evidence, not anatomy or imaging kinetics.
Endocrine exclusion, unresolved imaging and management-changing histology, with specialist review.
Complete actual venous/organ margins and acquired regional/distant field; unacquired disease is unknown.

targets: Every actual duct branch/variant, stricture, filling defect, vessel interface, acquired disease site and device
Actual source projection, field, original sampling, phase/sequence and temporal/drainage context
Histology, endocrine/clinical function and procedural suitability remain independently evidenced

source_scope_issues.detail: Named prototypes are not exhaustive patient-specific branches, variants or observations.
Older source surgical, diagnostic length and congenital classification statements require full current specialist reconciliation.
Static morphology does not establish malignant histology, infection diagnosis, organ dysfunction or device patency.
Peripheral branches, small duct disease and unacquired regions cannot be excluded by projection or limited field.
Every image/model needs native source resolution, modality, original reuse evidence and independent fine anatomical review.
Gallbladder wall, acute cholecystitis, stones and related management/quiz content require separate complete scope and clinical review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Source-confirmed segmental branching/communications with actual variant and unassessed-region evidence.
Original source sections and adequate modality evidence; no universal stone diagnosis from a static MRCP void.
Actual contrast phases/sequences with matched tissue, not colours on a model.
TG18 clinical/laboratory and organ dysfunction evidence, not imaging morphology alone.
Actual duct/vessel/lobar/distant extent and current specialist framework; no Bismuth-only operative verdict.
Actual device/anastomotic geometry plus appropriate independent clinical/procedural patency or leakage evidence.

targets: Every actual region, wall layer/lesion, material, duct/vessel interface, acquired complication and device
Actual scan coverage, resolution, modality, positions, temporal and clinical context
Dynamic tenderness/mobility/compressibility and flow need their own actual evidence

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype targets do not establish exhaustive patient-specific wall, material, variant and complication extent.
Static images and source envelopes cannot establish mobility, compression response, tenderness or clinical functionality.
Sonographic layers are not automatically resolved histological layers; source resolution and exact tissue mapping require review.
Imaging patterns do not replace TG18 local/systemic evidence, organ dysfunction or individualized clinical management.
Every source image/model needs native acquisition evidence, original rights and independent anatomical/clinical review.
The rest of the shared gallbladder/duct/stone lesson and management assertions remain under separate full review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual position-change assessment or appropriate temporal sequence, with slow movement and incomplete visibility limits.
Actual before/during compression observation; a round still-frame contour cannot prove hydrops.
Direct documented probe-site/control-site response with assessability and clinical limitations.
Actual Doppler acquisition/settings and adequately resolved wall/vessel sites, not model colours.
TG18 clinical/systemic evidence and relevant organ dysfunction, not wall thickness or images alone.
Original wall/collection/gas/fistula geometry and clinical/source correspondence, not parent-envelope inference.

Unvisualised regions, limited resolution and temporal passage cannot be equated with complete negative anatomy.
Transabdominal, endoscopic and intraoperative source geometry/performance are distinct; stills cannot prove mobility or flow.
ASGE and TG18 require selected population and clinical/laboratory context; no diameter-only ERCP or imaging-only syndrome/severity verdict is introduced.
Every source image/model needs native protocol/resolution, original rights and independent anatomical review.
Shared biliary/gallbladder/stone management and curriculum content still require full reconciliation.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual directly acquired segment/outlet coverage with unassessed field boundaries.
Source-confirmed defect, margin and appropriate acoustic discrimination, not model colours or universal shadow assumption.
Actual documented positional/temporal comparison; a cine file alone does not prove stone mobility.
Adequate actual Doppler source and correct vessel/duct sites, not colour on a mesh.
Named framework, relevant history, labs and clinical criteria; imaging morphology alone does not diagnose/grade syndromes.
Actual dated original anatomy/device/field evidence; pneumobilia does not prove stent or outlet patency.

targets: Every actual bowel loop/segment, transition, vessel/branch, hernia/lesion and complication interface
Actual acquired field, original contrast phases, native sampling and temporal/postoperative context
Independent clinical viability/cause and surgical urgency assessment

source_scope_issues.detail: Named prototypes are not exhaustive acquired loops/branches/defects or patient-specific connectivity.
Model colours or unavailable contrast cannot provide actual enhancement or clinical viability.
An unseen transition cause or prior surgery does not prove a specific adhesive band.
ASBO guidance is not a universal management algorithm for every small/large bowel obstruction or postoperative setting.
Every source figure/model requires native sampling/phase, rights and independent complete anatomical review.
Wider closed-loop/volvulus/pathophysiology/management and quiz content need separate complete review.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Full original acquired bowel and both transition connections; a C/U sketch is not complete source topology.
Actually acquired suitable contrast/phase and adequately imaged reference wall; unavailable enhancement stays unassessed.
Actual feeding/draining branches and twisted/compressed source interfaces, not parent vascular labels.
Actual source lesion/band/defect or explicitly qualified inference with clinical/surgical context.
Source anatomy plus clinical examination/physiology and specialist judgement; normal-looking enhancement is not a guarantee.
Every actual affected loop/wall/mesentery/collection and unassessed field, not a selective single-frame claim.

targets: Every actual supplying/draining branch, segment, injury site and interface
Original native source phases, field, resolution and temporal/intervention correspondence
Independent clinical mechanism/viability and specialist assessment

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype targets are not exhaustive patient-specific vascular/segment/injury instances.
Missing phases and baseline attenuation cannot provide normal contrast enhancement or complete vascular patency.
Source colours, wall patterns or pneumatosis do not establish histological extent, mechanism or complete clinical viability.
All native sources, protocols, rights and fine anatomical validation remain required.
Wider arterial/venous/reperfusion management and quiz/curriculum content require complete independent reconciliation.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Adequately acquired/opacified source vessels and actual branches, not a normal preset or parent artery label.
Actual baseline/contrast phase comparisons with source reference wall; high baseline attenuation is not enhancement.
Exact arterial/venous/mechanical/temporal findings plus clinical/physiological context.
Full source wall/injury context and specialist clinical assessment; no histological certainty from one sign.
Every actual vascular/segment injury and unassessed/unacquired region or source limit.

targets: Every actual covered segment, wall observation, lesion component, vessel branch, mesenteric/peritoneal and adjacent-organ interface
Source-specific distension, baseline/contrast phase, spatial extent, diagnosis/pathological state and population
Independent anatomical and clinical review; the patterns are not histological or complete perfusion proof

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft segment/feature groups are not exhaustive actual patient-specific instances.
Missing phases, collapsed segments and unresolved wall bands remain limited/unassessed, not normal anatomy.
Length schemes, thickness chart means, symmetry and target/fat patterns do not independently establish a specific cause or benignity.
Image, schematic and 3D candidates require source-specific resolution, rights and complete anatomical review.
Whole shared bowel-ischaemia lesson, quiz, imaging algorithms and treatment guidance remain independently unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual measurement site, plane, local distension and observable wall margins.
Actually acquired contrast/reference and baseline sources, with unresolved phases and field limits retained.
Every involved and assessed intervening segment, lesion margin and conditional covered interface.
Source observations plus clinical/endoscopic/pathological context; no diagnosis from source scheme or appearance alone.
Adequately opacified covered vessels and full relevant wall/injury assessment with independent specialist context.

targets: Every actual lesion/component, bowel segment and separate primary/mesenteric/nodal/spread observation
Complete source branch and interface identities with actual distension, acquisition phases and spatial extent
Independent diagnostic/histological framework, source rights and anatomical/clinical review

source_scope_issues.detail: Prototype groups require full case-specific site/component/branch instantiation and anatomical validation.
Unassessed or inadequately acquired bowel/liver/vascular regions cannot become negative tumour/spread/patency conclusions.
Appearance, low attenuation, encasement or model colours do not establish histology, grade, microscopic invasion or operative suitability.
Every source image, schematic and model needs appropriate rights, acquisition and fidelity evidence.
Whole shared tumour/foreign-body lesson, quiz, staging and management content remain independently unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual source bowel/adjacent-organ interfaces, distension and complete covered extent.
Actual contrast phases and reference regions; similarly enhancing lesions may remain inconspicuous.
Observed morphology plus independent clinical/pathological context, not pattern-only histology or biological risk.
Full actual vessel/host interfaces, opacification and abnormality margins; source contact is not microscopic invasion.
Actual acquired liver/peritoneal and other covered-site survey with occult/unassessed limits retained.

targets: Every actual object, component, endpoint, host segment and injury/collection/organ/vessel interface
Distinct actual radiographic projection and CT source planes/windows/calibration
Case-specific age, object/material uncertainty, longitudinal correspondence and independent clinical/anatomical review

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft groups require every actual endpoint/object/component/site to be instantiated and reviewed.
Radiographic projection, a negative limited examination or parent anatomy cannot supply CT depth, material or complete object extent.
Free-gas absence, projected proximity and different field/projection do not independently exclude injury or establish penetration/migration.
Adult upper-GI guidance is source-qualified; paediatric/lower-GI and broader treatment algorithms remain separate review work.
Every image, schematic/model and clinical source/context requires appropriate provenance, rights and full fidelity validation.
Whole shared tumour/foreign-body lesson and quiz/management content remain unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Each actual complete source-visible object and endpoints, calibrated dimensions and source visibility limits.
Actual CT wall/organ/vessel planes and opacification; a projection does not prove depth or penetration.
Full relevant local/remote wall, gas, inflammatory and collection assessment with source limits.
Reliable identity and source correspondence, not projection or coverage differences.
Actual age, location, object/material/number and complications under the applicable independent clinical framework.

targets: Every actual source site, wall feature, narrowing, tract branch/endpoint, collection and host interface
Actual sequence/plane, diffusion/ADC, contrast and temporal/persistence evidence with field/distension limits
Independent source-specific anatomical, phenotypic and clinical review, including postoperative/pelvic boundaries

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft targets require full actual site, tract branch/endpoint and interface instantiation.
Generic MRI labels, CT, stills or model colours cannot supply unacquired sequence features, ADC correspondence or motility/fixedness.
Imaging phenotype does not independently quantify histological fibrosis or complete tissue activity; mixed processes and clinical context remain relevant.
Routine enterography field does not prove dedicated perianal or every extraintestinal region.
All source images, schematics, models, acquisition/right evidence and independent clinical/anatomical review remain required.
Whole shared IBD lesson, quiz, scoring, surveillance and treatment content remains unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual T2/fat-suppressed and contrast sources with reference tissue, distension and resolved bands.
Actual DWI, b-value/ADC and same-site source context; no feature borrowed from CT or another panel.
Reliable actual cine/repeated/temporal evidence and source calibre, not an isolated collapsed loop.
Complete source-visible tract/branch/endpoints, collection and host interfaces with unresolved limits retained.
Actual matched prior/current sites, sequences, distension and source correspondence.
Integrated observed predominant/mixed features and independent clinical interpretation; no standalone fibrosis fraction or automatic remission.

reporting_checklist.label: Activity
reporting_checklist.detail: Review vascularity, ulceration and surrounding mesenteric fat.

reporting_checklist.label: Lumen And Complications
reporting_checklist.detail: Assess peristalsis, stenosis, dilatation and penetrating disease.

reporting_checklist.label: Mimics And Comparison
reporting_checklist.detail: Check appendiceal, infectious, diverticular and other focal mimics.

targets: Every actual bowel segment, band/caliper, narrowing, tract branch/endpoint, collection and host/mimic interface
Actual Doppler acquisition/settings and real-time compression/motion/persistence evidence
Independent source, anatomical, phenotype and clinical review; all inaccessible fields retained

source_scope_issues.detail: Every actual region and tract/interface needs explicit source instantiation.
Acoustic bands do not independently establish every histological layer or pathological depth.
Real-time/repeated source and Doppler settings are needed; static images and colours cannot supply dynamics/perfusion.
Observed patterns do not independently establish pathogen, full histology, quantified fibrosis or complete remission.
Inaccessible/deep/pelvic extent and unresolved endpoints cannot become complete exclusions.
Images, schematics, models and independent specialist validation remain required.
Shared IBD lesson, scoring and management content remains unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual B-mode source plane/caliper and resolved acoustic interfaces with pressure/obliquity limits.
Actual acquired settings, mural/perimural source and technical/artefact assessment.
Real-time/cine/repeated sources for motion, compressibility and persistence.
Every source-visible course, branch and endpoint with unresolved extent retained.
Actual matched sites, dates, technique and compression/Doppler context.

source_scope_issues.detail: Named regions require actual case-specific sites, margins, branches and interfaces.
Missing phases or early injury timing cannot supply complete bleeding, duct, bowel or perfusion exclusion.
Excretory opacification does not substitute for adequate retrograde bladder cystography.
Organ-specific revision and complete criterion evidence remain necessary; no universal 2018 default.
Partial source tracks/fields cannot complete every crossing, entry/exit or associated injury.
Clinical images, faithful schematics/3D and independent specialist review remain pending.
The whole abdominal-trauma lesson, quiz, scoring and management content remains unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual corresponding phase/time and blood-pool context with source extent.
Actual contrast source and physiological context; no independent viability credit from colour.
Source-visible continuity/disruption and actual appropriate urinary/duct examination.
Actual source sites and early/limited uncertainty, not absent gas as complete exclusion.
Complete source-supported course/crossings with unresolved extent retained.
Actual organ-specific scale/year and complete criterion evidence.

reporting_checklist.label: Peritoneum And Vessels

reporting_template_sections.heading: PAIN LOCALISATION
reporting_template_sections.body: Clinical pain site/context: [ ]. Actual source modality and coverage: [adequate / limited / unassessed]. Observed corresponding and alternative findings, unassessed regions and certainty: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: BOWEL AND APPENDIX
reporting_template_sections.body: Appendix visualisation: [seen / partly seen / not seen / not assessed], actual source findings/limits [ ]. Bowel/diverticular/transition assessment: [adequate / limited / unassessed], each actual site, wall/lumen and complication extent [ ]. Ultrasound dynamics/Doppler or contrast-dependent observations: actual acquired source [ ] or unassessed [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: SOLID ORGANS
reporting_template_sections.body: Actual hepatobiliary/pancreatic/splenic assessment: [adequate / limited / unassessed], source regions/features [ ]. Ultrasound tenderness/Murphy/compression: [actually assessed / limited / unassessed]. Contrast/sequence-dependent observations and unresolved extent: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: URINARY AND PELVIC STRUCTURES
reporting_template_sections.body: Urinary assessment: [adequate actual source / limited / unassessed], drainage/stone and source coverage [ ]. Relevant pelvic organs and actual assessment: [ ], findings and inaccessible/unassessed extent [ ]. Modality/contrast/Doppler limits: [ ].

reporting_template_sections.heading: PERITONEUM AND VESSELS
reporting_template_sections.body: Peritoneal/vascular assessment: [adequate actual source / limited / unassessed]. Actual fluid/gas/collection sites, resolved wall/host extent, vessels and source phases/flow observations: [ ]. Unresolved cause, perforation/perfusion or field limits: [ ].

targets: Every actual pain/organ/bowel/appendix/duct/vessel/collection and host site

Actual patient/developmental/pregnancy/postoperative context and unresolved field

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft named regions require every actual source site, margin, branch and interface.
CT cannot supply sonographic compression/Murphy/Doppler, and projections cannot supply resolved organ-wall anatomy.
Unseen appendix, inaccessible bowel/organ/pelvis and missing source phases remain unresolved.
Location, wall/fat/fluid/nodal patterns alone do not prove pathogen, full cause, histology or viability.
Adult nonpregnant/nonlocalised scenarios are not universal rules for every patient or localised/postoperative question.
Complete images/schematics/3D, native acquisition and independent clinical review remain required.
Whole acute-abdomen lesson, quiz, scoring, differential/management guidance remains unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual examined region and clinically supplied pain context; no inferred single cause.
Actual compression/tenderness/Murphy/motion source and Doppler settings.
Actual acquired CT phase or MRI sequence and corresponding source site.
Actual radiographic field/projection and explicit unresolved soft-tissue limits.
Complete source-visible wall/host, transition, vessel and collection interfaces with unresolved extent retained.

source_scope_issues.detail: Draft targets need actual case-specific defects, contents and full host interfaces.
Static CT cannot establish reducibility, every adhesion or physiological tolerance.
Loss-of-domain terms need actual source volumes, boundaries and explicitly named denominator/method.
Unseen mesh/repair features cannot become absent; full operative/material context remains necessary.
Source appearance/colour or absent phases cannot establish every vascular/viability or infection conclusion.
Complete clinical images/schematics/3D and independent specialist review remain required.
Whole shared peritoneum/mesentery/wall lesson, quiz/scoring and surgical/management guidance remains unreconciled.

functional_evidence_requirements.evidence: Actual resolved fascial margins, source planes/posture and calibration; sac and neck separate.
Actual clinical/dynamic source; unavailable assessment retained.
Source HSV/residual ACV, segmentation/approximation bounds, method and named denominator.
Actual visible mesh/fixation/scar with operative and nonvisualisation limits.
Actual contrast/reference, bowel/mesenteric/tract source and unresolved viability/extent.

expansion_rules: Instantiate each actual tumour, interface, tract and node; child IDs are a known floor, never a substitute for multiple actual sites.
Retain separately reportable layers and both sides of paired anatomy and nodal stations.
Supplementary systemic staging, fistula and treated-bed sources remain conditional with explicit timing/coverage.
Every leaf needs independently reviewed image, schematic and model evidence; present landmark descriptors do not supply clinical fidelity.
source_scope_issues: Anal and rectal TNM rules must not be interchanged. Record histology, epicentre and named staging edition before assigning a category.
NCI PDQ presents AJCC8 tables; source-specific anal-margin/histology wording needs specialist reconciliation, not automatic inheritance of anal-canal staging.
Dentate line is not assumed directly visible on MRI.
No universal MRI node size rule is introduced; station, morphology and uncertainty remain explicit.
ACR narrative and complete SAR paper were not retrievable through web tool; abstract/search extracts are not claimed as full guideline review.
The public ExACT form has historical N2/N3 and M2 options; these are not adopted as current TNM categories. Named edition and clinical review remain mandatory.
ExACT MRI/clinical datasets are currently unavailable under NIH controlled-access terms. Public form rights do not grant MRI or patient-data access.

The form combines superficial/deep inguinal fields and puts obturator in a posteromedial external-iliac field. Preserve the explicit subregions and unresolved grouping overlap without relabelling every source as anatomically equivalent.
The historical form uses an anterior sacral vessel label; actual presacral arterial terminology and correspondences remain unreconciled rather than inferred from its locator diagram.
functional_evidence_requirements: Greatest size requires complete acquired multiplanar boundaries and measurement calibration.
Positive invasion needs actual source evidence at the named organ interface; abutment or absent plane alone is insufficient.
Nodal malignancy, distant disease and treated-bed viability require appropriate source and clinical confirmation; no generic model can establish them.

expansion_rules: Instantiate every actual sac, leak, compartment, branch, access vessel, tract and repair component. Listed children are a known floor; multiple sites are never collapsed into one label.
All leaves require independently reviewed image, schematic and model evidence; anatomy labels, source rights and numeric controls do not grant clinical fidelity.
Preserve both sides, actual variants, acquired phases/coverage and conditional prior-repair/device history.
Uncovered aorta, runoff, organ territories and fistula endpoints remain unresolved rather than normal.
source_scope_issues: Original 2014 illustrations describe historical rupture mechanisms, not universal prediction or current device-selection rules.

The isolated crescent cohort is retrospective and excludes definitive rupture at index imaging; it does not justify deferring suspected rupture communication or introduce a universal size/triage threshold.
Guideline imaging-table search extracts are not a full guideline review; complete vascular-radiologist/vascular-team reconciliation remains required.
Aortoenteric examples include different patients; source figures 5/13 share one patient. No patient geometries may be joined across cases.
Flat CT volume renderings and parametric colour maps do not provide acquired geometry, centreline calibration or registered comparison.
Generic arch-focused procedural landmarks do not satisfy abdominal sac, branch, compartment, access, fistula or repair coverage.
functional_evidence_requirements: Rupture assessment requires actual acquired phases, wall/leak interfaces, covered haemorrhage extent and immediate clinical communication when suspected.
Calibre, size and growth require original calibrated voxel series, orthogonal plane/centreline method and comparable acquisition; bitmap HU or colour-map estimates are insufficient.
Perfusion, shunt flow, organ viability, fistula continuity and endoleak classification need appropriate source phases/dynamics and clinical confirmation.
Device suitability, operative outcome and infection diagnosis require actual planning/history and clinical evidence rather than a generic model or isolated negative view.
